body: Delta Air Lines' SkyMiles and American Airlines' AAdvantage are the two largest airline loyalty programs in the United States. AAdvantage was previously the country's largest airline loyalty program, but it has been overtaken by SkyMiles. The two programs are similar in many ways, yet they differ on the value of a mile, the path to elite status and the benefits of their co-branded credit cards, so each suits a different kind of traveller. The value of a mile is not a fixed figure, because it changes with each redemption, but it can be estimated from systemwide redemption prices. NerdWallet estimates one AAdvantage mile at 1.7 cents and one SkyMile at 1.2 cents, while The Points Guy estimates an AAdvantage mile at 1.45 cents and a SkyMile at 1.2 cents. Both put AAdvantage miles ahead of SkyMiles, and the source notes that Delta and United have both been criticised for devaluing their miles, giving AAdvantage a material advantage on redemption value.

On elite status, Delta has four main Medallion tiers, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond, requiring 5,000, 10,000, 15,000 and 28,000 Medallion Qualifying Dollars respectively, on top of general membership and the invite-only Delta 360 tier. American has four main tiers, Gold, Platinum, Platinum Pro and Executive Platinum, requiring 40,000, 75,000, 125,000 and 200,000 Loyalty Points, plus general membership and the invite-only ConciergeKey tier. American's points are easier to earn: the airline essentially awards one Loyalty Point for every eligible base mile earned, while Delta awards one MQD for every dollar spent on the base ticket price and associated fees on Delta-operated flights. Delta does not require members to actually fly to reach Medallion status, since MQDs can also be earned through credit card spending: the SkyMiles Platinum and Business Platinum cards earn $1 MQD per $20 spent, while the Reserve and Business Reserve cards earn $1 MQD per $10 spent.

On cards and other benefits, SkyMiles co-branded cards are issued by American Express and AAdvantage cards by Citi, with four personal cards on each side. At the top end, the AAdvantage Executive World Legend Mastercard provides unlimited Admirals Club access, while the Delta SkyMiles Reserve Amex grants 15 Sky Club visits a year unless the cardholder reaches $75,000 in annual spend; the annual fees are $695 and $650 respectively. SkyMiles miles never expire, whereas AAdvantage miles expire after 24 months. Delta is a SkyTeam member and American a oneworld member, and the source notes that oneworld Emerald, granted by American's top two tiers, sits above anything SkyTeam or Star Alliance offers. AAdvantage still uses an awards chart for partner-operated flights and allows upgrades from economy straight to business class, excluding basic economy fares, while Delta generally only permits upgrades to the next cabin class. The source's conclusion is that the deciding factor is often location: Atlanta is a major Delta hub and Dallas/Fort Worth a major American hub, and the network and schedules of the dominant airline at a fortress hub usually matter more than which program's perks are worth more on paper.
en.summary: NerdWallet values an AAdvantage mile at 1.7 cents and a SkyMile at 1.2 cents; The Points Guy puts them at 1.45 and 1.2 cents. AAdvantage miles are worth more and Loyalty Points are easier to earn, but SkyMiles never expire, and the network of the dominant airline at a traveller's home airport may matter more than the program math.
en.title: How much are Delta SkyMiles worth compared to American AAdvantage miles in 2026?

body: 達美航空SkyMiles與美國航空AAdvantage是美國兩大航空忠誠計畫。Simple Flying指出，美國航空AAdvantage曾是美國最大的航空忠誠計畫，如今已被達美航空SkyMiles超越；兩者雖然相似，但在哩程價值、會籍門檻與信用卡權益上有諸多差異，適合的客群也不同。哩程價值並非固定數字，會隨個別兌換而變動；以系統性的兌換價格估算，NerdWallet估計每哩AAdvantage哩程價值1.7美分、每哩SkyMiles價值1.2美分，The Points Guy則估計AAdvantage每哩1.45美分、SkyMiles每哩1.2美分。兩家機構的估值都顯示AAdvantage哩程價值高於SkyMiles；來源也提到，達美與聯合航空的哩程都曾遭批評貶值，而AAdvantage在兌換價值上具有實質優勢。

會籍門檻方面，達美航空設有銀卡、金卡、白金卡與鑽石卡四個美達麗尊爵會籍等級，分別需要5,000、10,000、15,000與28,000尊爵資格美元(MQD)，另有一般會員與僅限邀請的Delta 360；美國航空則有金卡、白金卡、白金專業卡與行政白金卡四個等級，分別需要40,000、75,000、125,000與200,000忠誠點數(LP)，另有一般會員與僅限邀請的ConciergeKey。來源指出，美國航空的忠誠點數較容易累積，基本上每賺取1哩符合資格的基本哩程即獲得1點；達美航空則按達美營運航班基本票價與相關費用每花費1美元給予1尊爵資格美元，聯名信用卡消費另有換算方式，SkyMiles白金卡與商務白金卡每消費20美元累積1尊爵資格美元，Reserve卡與商務Reserve卡則為每10美元累積1尊爵資格美元。達美航空不要求會員實際搭乘即可取得尊爵會籍，搭乘或信用卡消費皆可累積。

信用卡與其他權益方面，SkyMiles聯名卡由美國運通發行，AAdvantage聯名卡由花旗銀行發行，兩者各有四張個人信用卡。頂級卡方面，AAdvantage Executive World Legend Mastercard提供無限次Admirals Club貴賓室使用權，達美SkyMiles Reserve美國運通卡每年僅提供15次Sky Club貴賓室造訪，除非持卡人年消費達75,000美元；年費分別為695美元與650美元。SkyMiles哩程永不過期，AAdvantage哩程則在24個月後失效。聯盟方面，達美航空屬於天合聯盟，SkyMiles會員可獲得相應的天合聯盟菁英會籍；美國航空屬於寰宇一家，最高兩個等級的會員可獲得寰宇一家綠寶石會籍，來源指出其權益高於天合聯盟或星空聯盟提供的最高等級。AAdvantage對夥伴航空營運的航班仍使用獎勵兌換表，並允許經濟艙直接升等商務艙（不含基本經濟艙票價），達美航空一般僅允許升等至下一個艙等；美國航空的忠誠點數里程碑獎勵自15,000點起，達美航空的自選獎勵則僅限白金卡與鑽石卡會員。來源的結論是，哩程價值與權益之外，旅客居住地與主場航空公司的航網往往才是決定性因素，例如亞特蘭大是達美航空樞紐、達拉斯—沃斯堡是美國航空樞紐。
zh.summary: NerdWallet估計每哩AAdvantage哩程價值1.7美分、每哩SkyMiles價值1.2美分，The Points Guy則估計為1.45美分與1.2美分。AAdvantage哩程價值較高、忠誠點數也較容易累積，但SkyMiles哩程永不過期；來源指出，旅客居住地主場航空公司的航網，往往比計畫本身的權益更具決定性。
